title: The Crab Derby, 2008
logline: Twenty-fourth annual. The flyer runs in the Newport weekly as an ad. Gully paid for the ad. Twenty bucks, plus the ad.

panels.composition: Gully's. GULLY with the Newport weekly open to a quarter-page ad: the crab flyer, printed. WOOD on the stool. BARNABY.

characters.pose: holding a newspaper open to an ad

balloons.text: Quarter page. Forty bucks. Your crab's in the paper before your strip is.

image.prompt: a man in an apron holding a local weekly open to a quarter-page ad showing a hand-drawn crab flyer, a thin man on a stool, a dog, muddy flats

panels.composition: The ad. The crab on newsprint. Dot gain fattening the hatching.

image.prompt: close-up of a newsprint ad with a hatched crab drawing, the ink fattened by dot gain

panels.composition: Wood drawing this year's on the counter. Two crabs, a cup, and — the small third crab from last year has moved closer to the first.

image.prompt: close-up of a hand drawing a crab flyer where a small third crab sits closer to the large first one than before

panels.composition: Fourteen flyers. Gully pinning. The ad pinned beside them, the first printed thing on that wall.

characters.pose: pinning the ad beside the flyers

image.prompt: fourteen crab flyers in a row on a shingle wall with a newspaper ad pinned beside them, a man in an apron stepping back, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; Sundays the point
